author: GitHub
description:
Development doesn’t happen only in your editor, and it rarely happens alone. Join Meagan to see how Copilot in Teams and Slack lets you work with AI alongside your teammates, right in the conversation. Plus, see how we’re streamlining chat across GitHub.com and the mobile app to bring Copilot to more of your daily development workflow. 

▬▬▬▬▬▬ WANT TO LEARN MORE? 🚀  ▬▬▬▬▬▬ 

Get hands-on with the Copilot app https://gh.io/ghcpdaycopilotapp
Check out Copilot app resources  https://gh.io/ghcpdaycopilotappresources
Install the GitHub Copilot CLI https://gh.io/ghcpdaycopilotcli

title: GitHub Copilot everywhere: building code across Slack, Teams, mobile, and VS Code
